Acá se compra hablando con el proveedor 💬 👉 Paso 1: Buscá tu producto, compará precios y verificá proveedores ✔️ Años en la plataforma ✔️ Cantidad de ventas ✔️ Buenas reviews 👉 Paso 2: Escribile directamente al proveedor Pedile: 📦 Precio 📦 MOQ (mínimo de compra) 📦 Personalización (logo, packaging, etc.) ⚠️ Tip CLAVE: Usá dirección en China 🇨🇳, no envíes a EE.UU. Buscá un courier/importadora → vas a ahorrar tiempo y dolores de cabeza 👉 Paso 3: Negociás todo y le pedís que te genere la orden Pagás dentro de Alibaba (seguro 🔒) Y listo… compra hecha 🚀 Así de simple. Ordering furniture from China isn’t as simple as finding a cute sofa on Alibaba and hitting “add to cart.” 😂 There’s a whole process between finding the furniture and having that container sitting at your warehouse. Manufacturers. Negotiations. Production. Freight. Customs. Port fees. Final delivery. And baby… there are PLENTY of opportunities to make an expensive mistake in between. Ask me how I know. 😭😂 I’ve been importing inventory for years, and learning how to source overseas completely changed the way I was able to grow my rental inventory. So if importing is something you’re seriously considering, learn the process BEFORE you start sending people your money. I put what I’ve learned—including manufacturers I’ve actually sourced from—inside my Luxury Inventory Sourcing Blueprint. Comment IMPORT and I’ll send you the information. 💕 Learn first. Then spend.

Before you order ANYTHING from Alibaba, know these 5 things. 👀 DDP vs. FOB, manufacturers vs. trading companies, Trade Assurance, getting everything in writing, and knowing your local requirements BEFORE you place that order. These are some of the biggest things I learned ordering for our custom home from China. Ordering from Alibaba?
